ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Fraud Probe
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota fraud probe, including the $3.3 million received by anti-ICE activists
questions: What is the source of the $3.3 million?
How is the money being used?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a complex web of financial transactions and could lead to further investigations and arrests.
